mechanism_narrative: The observed upward trend in RETAIL_REC mobility over the last two weeks indicates a sustained recovery in consumer activity, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The significant week-on-week increase in PARKS mobility suggests improving weather conditions or a shift towards outdoor activities, which will positively spill over into general retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next two weeks despite PARKS showing a week-on-week rise greater than 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: A combined and sustained increase in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility signals a stronger return to office-based work and commuting, directly boosting weekday retail and recreation activities over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both show positive week-on-week changes for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days even if both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT show sustained positive week-on-week changes.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates people are spending less time at home, freeing up time for out-of-home activities, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decreases over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL mobility continues its downward trend.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained upward trend in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, representing essential outings, often acts as a leading indicator for broader comfort with out-of-home activities, driving RETAIL_REC up over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM shows a positive change for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the next two weeks despite GROCERY_PHARM showing sustained positive week-on-week changes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decrease in RESIDENTIAL mobility and increase in PARKS mobility signifies a strong shift towards outdoor and public leisure, indicating a broader willingness to engage in out-of-home activities, boosting RETAIL_REC in the immediate next week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls and PARKS rises week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in the next week when RESIDENTIAL falls and PARKS rises week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The gradual but consistent recovery in WORKPLACES mobility, even if slow, indicates a steady return to pre-pandemic routines, which will incrementally support RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES continues to show an upward trend, but RETAIL_REC shows no improvement over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The broad-based recovery across multiple mobility categories (RETAIL_REC, GROCERY_PHARM, PARKS, TRANSIT) suggests an underlying easing of public health concerns or policy restrictions, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC upwards over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Despite a broad recovery across multiple mobility categories, RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days.
